DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お振込みで何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having trouble making a transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 保存した振込先に父と書いた物が二つありました。呼び名だけで選ばず、どちらの口座か確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父という保存名二件を呼び名だけで選ばず確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found two saved recipients labelled Dad. I want to check whose accounts they are rather than choose by that label alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to check the two entries saved as Dad rather than choose by the label alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身で付けた表示名ですね。二つの受取人の名前は読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Those are display names you assigned yourself. Can you read both recipients' names?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 片方は父の名前で、もう片方は以前家族の用事で使った別の人の名前です。私が同じ呼び名で保存してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 父名義と別人名義に自分が同じ呼び名を付けたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: One is my father's name, and the other is someone else whose account I previously used for a family matter. I accidentally saved both under the same label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you assigned the same label to your father's account and another person's account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 呼び名と口座の名義を分けて確認してください。今、振込の操作は確定していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the label separately from the account holder's name. Have you confirmed the transfer yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。父の口座情報を控えと照らし合わせてから、使う先を選び直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 振込未確定で父の控えと情報を照合後選び直すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I'll compare my father's account details with my record, then select the correct recipient again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the transfer is unconfirmed and you will compare the details with your record of your father's account before selecting again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。保存名の変更についても、操作案内を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. You can also check the instructions for changing a saved name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 別の人の口座は父という呼び名を残さないよう整理したいです。ただ、呼び名を変えるだけで名義が変わるわけではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別人の保存名を整理しても名義変更ではないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to tidy up the other person's saved account so it no longer says Dad. But changing the label alone doesn't change the account holder, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that editing the other person's saved name does not change the account holder.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、表示名の整理と振込先の情報の確認は別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. Organizing display names and checking recipient details are separate things.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名義と口座情報を確認して父の方だけ選びます。保存名の整理はその後に行い、今は確定せず確認を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 情報照合で父宛先を選び保存名整理は別に行うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the account holder and account details and select only my father's entry. I'll organize the saved names afterwards; for now I'll continue checking without confirming.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will identify your father's recipient entry by checking the details and organize saved labels separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認する項目をこちらでご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll explain which items to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お買い物のお手伝いはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Can I help you with your shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この惣菜を二百グラムほど買いたいです。容器を量りに載せたら重さが出たので、食品の分をどう量るか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 惣菜二百グラム希望で空容器の重量と食品重量の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like about two hundred grams of this prepared food. The scale showed a weight when I put the container on it. Could you explain how to weigh just the food?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want two hundred grams of prepared food and ask how the empty container's weight and food weight are handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ中身は入っていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You haven't put any food in yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、空の容器だけで表示が出ています。この数字まで食品の量として数えるのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未投入空容器の数値を食品へ数えるか不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. It's showing a number for the empty container alone. I don't know whether that number also counts towards the food amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the empty container already gives a reading and you don't know whether that counts as food weight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 容器の重さを区別して量る方法をご案内します。まず表示を食品分の基準に合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll show you how to weigh it separately from the container. First we adjust the display to the starting point for weighing the food.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。容器ごと二百グラムにすると、食品はそれより少なくなるということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 容器込み二百なら食品は二百未満になるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. If the container and contents together weigh two hundred grams, that means there's less food than that, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that two hundred grams including the container means less than two hundred grams of food.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのとおりです。基準を合わせた後に惣菜を入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Exactly. Add the prepared food after setting the starting point.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は空の容器でゼロになりました。ここから食品を入れて、二百グラムに近づけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 空容器ゼロ表示から食品を二百に近づけると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The scale now says zero with the empty container. I'll add the food from here and bring it close to two hundred grams.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will add food to reach about two hundred grams from the zero reading with the empty container.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示と商品を確認して、会計へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the display and the item, then proceed to checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 食品だけで二百グラムですね。容器を別の物に替える時は、この基準のままにせずもう一度方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食品重量を確認し容器を替えたら基準も再確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: So it's two hundred grams of food alone. If I switch to a different container, I won't keep this setting; I'll check the method again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the food weight in Japanese and say that you will recheck the starting point if you change containers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。量り方でお困りでしたらまたお呼びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please call me again if you need help weighing anything.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園で何かご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Would you like to ask about something in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このベンチに座りたいのですが、横の札が裏返っていて読めません。新しく塗ったように見えるので、使う前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 裏返札と新塗装らしいベンチを未使用のまま利用可否確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to sit on this bench, but the sign beside it is facing backwards and I can't read it. It looks freshly painted, so I want to check before using it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can use the apparently newly painted bench with the reversed sign, without having used it yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 札には触れましたか。ベンチにはもう座っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you touched the sign? Have you sat on the bench already?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どちらにも触っていません。別のベンチより色が明るく、近くに塗装の道具があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未接触で明るい塗装と付近道具を見たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't touched either. The colour is brighter than the other benches, and there are painting tools nearby.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have touched neither and noticed brighter paint and tools nearby.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そこは作業中の区画です。今はベンチを使わず、離れてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: That area is being worked on. Please don't use the bench now; wait away from it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。乾いているか手で確かめず、家族もそこへ座らないように伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 作業中と知り手で乾きを試さず家族にも座らないよう伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I won't check whether it's dry with my hand, and I'll tell my family not to sit there either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that now you know work is underway, you will not test dryness by hand and will tell your family not to sit there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 読めない札についてはこちらで担当に知らせます。ご自身で道具を動かす必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll let the person responsible know about the unreadable sign. You don't need to move any tools yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、札を表に返してよいと思っていましたが、作業区画へ入らず、読めなかった位置だけ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分で札や道具を動かさず区画外から読めなかった位置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: All right. I thought I could turn the sign around, but I'll stay outside the work area and just explain where I couldn't read it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese from outside the area where the sign was unreadable, without moving the sign or tools yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。休むなら、作業区画外のベンチをご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. If you'd like to rest, I can show you a bench outside the work area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族とそちらへ移ります。明るい色だから使えると決めず、作業中のベンチはそのままにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族と案内された別ベンチへ移り作業中の物は触らないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll move there with my family. I won't assume a bright colour means it's usable, and I'll leave the bench being worked on alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you and your family will move to the other bench indicated and leave the one being worked on untouched.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらのベンチをご利用ください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご乗車で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having any trouble with your journey?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 紙の切符が雨でにじみました。このまま通れるか分からないので、改札で使う前に見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: にじんだ切符を改札利用前に状態確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The print on my paper ticket has run in the rain. I don't know whether I can pass through with it, so I'd like you to look at it before I use the gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to have the smudged ticket checked before using it at the gate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その切符はお手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have that ticket with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、濡れた切符はこちらです。携帯には切符の写真もありますが、写真は昨日使った別の物でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現物あり携帯写真は昨日の別切符だと区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, here is the wet ticket. I also have a ticket photo on my phone, but that was a different ticket I used yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese between the physical ticket you have and the phone photo of a different ticket from yesterday.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今回の切符と以前の写真を分けて確認しましょう。今の切符をいつ買いましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check today's ticket separately from the earlier photo. When did you buy the current ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日、ここの窓口で買いました。財布に入れた控えも残っているので、一緒に示せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日窓口購入で購入控えも示せると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Today, at this counter. I still have the purchase slip in my wallet, so I can show you that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you bought it at the counter today and can also show the purchase slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が購入内容と切符の状態を確認します。昨日の写真を今回の切符として見せないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will check the purchase details and the ticket's condition. Please don't present yesterday's photo as this ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。今回の濡れた紙と控えを見せます。文字を自分でなぞって書き足すこともせず、そのまま持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今回現物と控えを出し文字を自己修正せず保持したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll show this wet paper ticket and its purchase slip. I brought it as it is, without tracing over or adding to the text myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will present the current physical ticket and slip and have kept it without altering the text yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その状態で確認します。担当の案内までお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check it in that condition. Please wait for the staff member's instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。昨日の写真で通ろうとせず、今日の購入について説明して、使えるかと次の手順を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧写真代用せず今日の購入と利用手順を担当へ確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: All right. I won't try to get through using yesterday's photo. I'll explain today's purchase and ask whether I can use this ticket and what to do next.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not substitute the old photo and will ask the staff member about today's purchase and the procedure for using the ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらで切符を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Let me look at your ticket here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。市役所の案内で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you need help with information at city hall?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この紙に避難という言葉があり、不安になりました。今起きている災害の知らせなのか、予定の案内なのか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 避難の語を見て現在災害か予定通知か確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: This paper has the word evacuation on it, and it worried me. I'd like to check whether it announces a disaster happening now or a scheduled event.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that seeing the word evacuation made you want to check whether this concerns a current disaster or a scheduled notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紙の見出しには、ほかにどんな言葉がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: What other words appear in the heading?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 防災訓練と書いてあります。日付は来週ですが、避難という言葉を先に見て、今すぐ出かけるのかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見出し防災訓練と来週日付を読み今すぐの行動と誤解したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says disaster preparedness drill. The date is next week, but I saw evacuation first and thought I had to leave immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read out the disaster preparedness drill heading and next week's date in Japanese and explain that you mistook it for an instruction to act immediately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: これは来週予定している訓練の案内です。この紙だけを現在の災害情報として読まないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is a notice about a drill scheduled for next week. Please don't read this paper alone as information about a current disaster.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。家族へも、今の避難指示ではなく訓練の予定だと伝えます。参加の申込みも別に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族へ今の避難指示でなく訓練と伝え申込は別確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll tell my family it's a scheduled drill, not a current evacuation instruction. I'd also like to check registration separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will tell your family this is a drill rather than a current evacuation instruction and want to check registration separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 参加する場合は、案内の対象と申込み方法をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you wish to participate, please check who the notice applies to and how to register.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の地区が対象かと、参加する日時を確認します。避難場所の名前だけで、今日そこへ行く予定はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象地区と参加日時を確認し今日避難場所へ行く予定にしないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check whether my district is included and the date and time for participating. I won't plan to go there today just because the evacuation site's name appears.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the eligible district and participation date and time and will not make plans to go to the evacuation site today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在の災害情報が必要な場合は、この予定案内とは別の情報を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you need current disaster information, please check information separate from this scheduled-event notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今の情報と来週の訓練を分けます。家族に紙全体の見出しと日付を伝えてから、参加について相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在情報と訓練予定を分け見出し日付ごと家族へ共有すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll keep current information separate from next week's drill. I'll tell my family the full heading and date before discussing participation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will distinguish current information from the drill schedule and share the heading and date together with your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。訓練の案内で分からない所はこちらへお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please ask here about anything unclear in the drill notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。問診票でお手伝いできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with the medical questionnaire?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このコピーは薄くて、いくつかの選択肢が読めません。書ける所は書きましたが、読めない所を何もない欄だと思って提出したくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薄い問診コピーの不可読箇所を空欄扱いせず用紙相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: This copy is faint, and I can't read some of the options. I've filled in what I can, but I don't want to submit it assuming the unreadable parts are just empty spaces.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about the faint medical questionnaire copy without treating unreadable areas as blank fields.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの辺りが見えにくいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which part is difficult to see?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 右下です。文字の一部と四角い枠が消えていて、何を選ぶのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 右下文字と枠が欠け選択内容不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The bottom right. Some text and square boxes have disappeared, so I don't know what I'm supposed to select.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that text and boxes are missing at the bottom right and the choices are unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 読みやすい用紙を用意します。今の紙に書いた情報も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll get you a readable form. Let's also check the information you wrote on this one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。名前と今日の日付は書きました。読めない所へ、適当に印を付けたりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名前日付のみ記入し不可読欄へ適当な印はないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I've written my name and today's date. I haven't put random marks in the parts I can't read.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have filled in only your name and date and have not randomly marked unreadable fields.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 新しい紙では、右下に二つの選択肢があります。内容を読んでからお答えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: On the new form, there are two options at the bottom right. Please read them before answering.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は読めます。古いコピーで枠が一つに見えたので、選択肢が二つあるとは分かりませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新用紙で二選択を読め旧コピーは一枠に見えたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can read them now. The old copy looked like it had only one box, so I didn't realize there were two options.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you can read the two options on the new form, whereas the old copy appeared to have one box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりにくい用紙で申し訳ありません。ほかにも読めない所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'm sorry the form was unclear. Are there any other parts you cannot read?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい紙は全体が読めます。名前と日付を写した後、選択肢は自分の状況を確認して書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 読みやすい全紙へ名前日付を移し選択は状況確認後答えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can read the whole new form. After copying my name and date, I'll check my situation and fill in the choices again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will copy your name and date onto the fully readable form and answer the choices after checking your circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。書き終わりましたら、こちらへご提出ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please submit it here when you've finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご相談のお手伝いはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 近所の人とのことで相談に来ました。相手も来ると聞きましたが、一緒に話す前に私だけで事情を説明できるか尋ねたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 近隣相手との同席前に一人で事情説明できるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've come to discuss an issue with a neighbour. I heard the other person is coming too, but before speaking together, I'd like to ask whether I can explain the situation alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can explain the circumstances alone before sitting together with the neighbour concerned.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相手の方は、今こちらにいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the other person here now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ見ていません。同じ待合場所へ呼ばれる前に、別に相談したいという希望を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相手未発見で同待合に呼ばれる前に別相談希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't seen them yet. Before we're called to the same waiting area, I'd like to say that I prefer a separate consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not seen the other person and want a separate consultation before being called to the same waiting area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 希望を担当へ伝えます。ここで全ての事情を、周囲に聞こえるように話す必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll pass your request to the person responsible. You don't need to explain every detail here where others can hear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。受付では名前と相談に来たことを伝え、詳しい内容は担当に話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付は必要事項のみで詳細は担当へ話すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I'll give reception my name and say I've come for a consultation, and discuss the details with the person responsible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will provide only the necessary information at reception and discuss details with the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が相談の進め方を確認します。相手の方に、ご自身で今連絡を取る予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person responsible will check how to proceed. Are you planning to contact the other person yourself now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今はありません。二人で話すと決まったわけではないので、私から同席の約束を送ったりしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現時点同席決定なしで自分から同席の約束連絡をしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not now. It hasn't been decided that we'll speak together, so I won't send them a message promising a joint meeting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that a joint meeting is not currently decided and you will not contact them to promise one yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別々に話したい理由についても、担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell the person responsible why you'd like to speak separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、落ち着いて経緯を説明したいからです。最初は一人で話す希望があると伝え、実際の進め方は担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 落ち着いて経緯説明したい理由と一人相談希望を担当へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, because I'd like to explain what happened calmly. I'll tell them I want to speak alone first, and check how things will actually proceed with them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese your wish to speak alone and your reason of calmly describing events, and check the procedure with the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。その希望を担当へ伝えますので、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll pass on your request, so please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。郵便のことで何をご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to ask about your mail?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人へ手紙を送りましたが、返事がありません。まだ届いていないのかと思って、控えを持ってきました。配達の表示を一緒に見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人から返事がなく未配達を心配して差出控えの配達表示の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I sent a letter to a friend, but I haven't had a reply. I wondered whether it hadn't arrived, so I brought my mailing receipt. Could you look at the delivery status with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to check the delivery status on your mailing receipt because your friend has not replied and you worry it was not delivered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 控えの番号で開いた画面は、こちらですね。昨日の配達済みという表示があります。どの点がご心配ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is the screen opened using the number on your receipt, correct? It says delivered yesterday. What concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 配達済みなら友人の返事も来ると思っていました。でも、相手が読んだか、返事を書いたかを示す表示ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 配達済みを返信も届く意味と誤解したと説明し読了や返信準備の表示でないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought that if it said delivered, my friend's reply would also arrive. But it doesn't show whether they read it or wrote a reply, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you misunderstood delivered as meaning a reply would arrive too, and confirm that it does not show reading or reply preparation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、ここにあるのは郵便物の配達状況です。友人が返事を用意したかは、この画面からは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct. This shows the delivery status of the mail. We can't tell from this screen whether your friend has prepared a reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。送り先も確認したいです。控えの住所は友人から先月教わった住所で、部屋番号もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先月教わった住所と部屋番号を控えで照合したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'd also like to check the destination. The address on the receipt is the one my friend gave me last month, and it includes the apartment number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to compare the address and apartment number given last month against your receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その控えと手元の住所を照らし合わせましょう。記載は一致していますね。配達についてほかに確認したい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's compare that receipt with the address you have. They match. Is there anything else you'd like to check about delivery?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今はありません。返事がないことだけで配達されなかったと決めず、友人へ受取りの確認を短く連絡したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 住所一致を確認し返事の不在で未配達と決めず友人へ受取りを尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not at present. I won't conclude it wasn't delivered just because there's no reply. I'd like to send my friend a brief message asking whether they received it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the matching address in Japanese and say that you will ask your friend about receipt without equating no reply with non-delivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 友人との連絡はご自身の方法でお願いします。控えと照会画面は、後で確認できるよう保管できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please contact your friend in your own way. You can keep the receipt and tracking screen to check later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 控えを残します。友人には手紙が届いたかだけ先に聞き、返事を急がせません。配達の照会と返事のお願いを分けられました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控えを保持し友人には到着確認だけ先に連絡して返事を急がせないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep the receipt. I'll first ask my friend only whether the letter arrived, without rushing a reply. I now understand delivery tracking and asking for a reply are separate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will retain the receipt, initially contact your friend only to confirm arrival, and will not rush their reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示をご確認いただきありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Thank you for checking the display. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。請求のご相談で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having trouble with a billing enquiry?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: カードの請求に知らない名前があります。買った店の名前と違いますが、すぐ別の取引と決めず調べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未知カード請求名を違う店名だけで別取引と決めず調べたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's a name I don't recognize on my card bill. It's different from the shop's name, but I'd like to investigate without immediately deciding it's a different transaction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to investigate an unfamiliar card-billing name without deciding it is another transaction simply because the shop name differs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご利用の日付や金額に、思い当たる記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have any records that seem to match the date or amount?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ日の控えに同じ金額があります。ただ、控えの店名は違うので、同じ取引かはまだ分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同日日付同額の店控えはあるが名前差で同一未確定と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a receipt with the same amount on the same day. But the shop name on it is different, so I still don't know whether it's the same transaction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have a shop receipt with a matching date and amount, but the differing name means the transaction is not yet identified.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 請求内容はカードの担当へ確認してください。控えと請求の表示を両方残して相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the billing details with your card provider. You can keep both the receipt and billing display when consulting them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、控えを捨てずに持ちます。金額が同じという理由だけで、問題ないと結論にもしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 両記録を保持し同額だけで問題なしとしないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I'll keep the receipt rather than throw it away. I also won't conclude everything is fine just because the amount matches.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep both records and will not decide there is no problem based only on the matching amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ、何を見比べたか伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell the person responsible what you compared.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 日付と金額は一致し、名前は違うと説明します。ほかに同じ金額を使った記録があるかも自分の控えで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一致した日付金額と異なる名を担当へ伝え他記録も探すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll explain that the date and amount match but the name differs. I'll also check my receipts for any other record of spending the same amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell the person responsible in Japanese which date and amount matched and which name differed, and say that you will look for other records too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認の案内先はこちらです。銀行の窓口だけで取引の正体を断定することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is where to direct your enquiry. A bank counter alone cannot conclusively identify the transaction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。確認前に記録を消さず、カードの担当へ照合を頼みます。店名の違いだけでも同額だけでも決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録を消さずカード担当へ照合依頼し名前や金額一条件で断定しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't delete the records before checking; I'll ask the card provider to compare them. I won't decide based only on the different shop name or the same amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep the records and request comparison from the card provider, without drawing conclusions from the name or amount alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの案内に従ってお問い合わせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please make your enquiry following these instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。商品について何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you with the product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この惣菜を家で温めたいです。ふたと容器をそのまま使えるか、買う前に表示を見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 惣菜ふたと容器をそのまま温められるか表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to heat this prepared food at home. Before buying it, could you look at the label to see whether I can use the lid and container as they are?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese what the label says about heating the prepared food in its existing lid and container.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品には温め方の表示があります。どの部分が分かりにくいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The product has heating instructions. Which part is unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ふたを外すと書いてある所です。容器の印を見て、ふたも一緒に使えると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ふた外し表示を見落とし容器印で全体使用可能と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The part saying to remove the lid. I saw the symbol on the container and thought I could use the lid with it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you overlooked the remove-lid instruction and thought the container symbol allowed using the whole package.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 容器の表示と、ふたの扱いは分けて読んでください。全体を閉めたままにするという案内ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please read the container label separately from the lid instructions. It does not instruct you to leave the whole thing closed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。家でふたを外し、温め方の表示をそのまま見ながら扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ふたを外す表示と温め方に従うと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. At home I'll remove the lid and handle it while following the heating instructions exactly as shown.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will follow the instruction to remove the lid and the heating directions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 容器を替える場合も、別の容器の取扱いをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you change containers, please also check the instructions for the other container.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家の大きな器へ移すかもしれません。その場合は、この容器の印を家の器にも当てはめないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家の器に替える時は商品容器印をその器へ適用しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I may transfer it to a large dish at home. If so, I'll make sure not to apply this container's symbol to my own dish.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that if you switch to a dish at home, you will not apply the product container's symbol to that dish.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 商品の温め方で、ほかに分からない所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is there anything else you don't understand about heating this product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今は大丈夫です。惣菜の表示と使う器の案内を確認し、ふたを閉めたままの加熱だと思わず準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食品表示と使用器案内を照合し密閉加熱と誤解せず準備すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'm fine for now. I'll check the food label and the instructions for the dish I use, and prepare it without assuming it should be heated sealed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will compare the food label and the dish instructions and prepare it without misunderstanding it as sealed heating.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご不明な所がありましたらまたお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please ask again if anything is unclear.
